in_sanskrit.name: सहदेवन्
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who is always with the Devas or Gods.

in_hindi.name: सहदेवन
in_hindi.long_meaning: देवों के साथ हमेशा रहने वाला व्यक्ति

in_marathi.name: Sahdevan
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sahdevan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from Sanskrit words 'sa' meaning 'with' and 'deva' meaning 'god'. Represents a divine gift from God.

in_bengali.name: Sahdevan
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ God's Gift
in_bengali.long_meaning: Sahdevan একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Derived from Sanskrit words 'sa' meaning 'with' and 'deva' meaning 'god'. Represents a divine gift from God.
